blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Mandaue City government has started distributing free school supplies to public elementary school students through its Eduk-Ahon program. The ceremonial turnover for Eduk-Ahon, dubbed “Sabay-sabay Tayong Aahon,” was held Wednesday, September 16. The initiative aims to provide assistance to learners in the city. Mayor Thadeo Jonkie Ouano, Congresswoman Emmarie Lolypop Ouano-Dizon, and city council members led the distribution. They handed out boxes filled with school supplies, including bags, notebooks, tumblers, ballpens, rulers, scissors, and raincoats, to help the children with their studies. “Atoa gyud gitan-aw ang quality, kanang durable, kanang molast og pila ka buwan,” said […]...
